_description: Split config for MEDITECH EHI export analysis. MEDITECH documents 2 export configurations based on which application modules a site has installed: Config 1 (HIM/SCN/PHM eChart-based) and Config 2 (MRI/DR CSV-based). Config 1 covers all platforms for acute but only modern platforms for ambulatory. Config 2 provides CSV-based export for older platforms. CS and MAGIC can use either config depending on installed modules. Each config gets its own analysis.

splits.focus: MEDITECH EHI Export Configuration 1 — sites using Health Information Management (HIM) and Scanning/eChart (SCN) modules. Exports: Electronic Chart documents + US Core FHIR R4 data + C-CDA documents + supplemental clinical/administrative/financial reports. Applicable platforms and settings: Expanse 2.2 (acute & ambulatory), Expanse 2.1 (acute & ambulatory), 6.15 (acute & ambulatory), 6.08 (acute only), Client/Server (acute only), MAGIC (acute only). Focus your analysis on the Config 1 specification page (ehiexportconfig1.html) and the main overview (ehiexport-main.html). Evaluate what data is exported, format completeness, and whether the eChart-based approach covers all EHI categories for each applicable platform/setting combination.

splits.focus: MEDITECH EHI Export Configuration 2 — sites using Medical Records Imaging (MRI) and Data Repository (DR) modules. Exports: Patient Data as CSV files + US Core FHIR R4 data + C-CDA documents + supplemental clinical/administrative/financial reports and images. Applicable platforms: 6.08/MPM (ambulatory only), Client/Server (acute & ambulatory), MAGIC (acute & ambulatory). Each platform has its own CSV data dictionary PDF: Client/Server uses csacuteandambehiexportdrsolutionmerged.pdf, MAGIC uses mgehiexportdrsolutionmerged.pdf, 6.08/MPM ambulatory uses 608ehiexportcsv.pdf. Focus your analysis on the Config 2 specification page (ehiexportconfig2.html), the platform-specific CSV data dictionary PDFs, and the main overview (ehiexport-main.html). Evaluate what data each platform's CSV export covers, differences between platforms, and completeness of EHI coverage.
